name: 2026-10-14-tileA-bytes-gh200
design: design-tile DESIGN.md corrected by design-tile-review REVIEW.md (the review wins) and the owner's decisions of 2026-10-14: D1 prefill now on the reachable wgmma tiles 64x128x64 w8 and 128x128x64 w8 (decode tiles later); D2 NATIVE certifies, SHARED secondary; D3 rental A's selection rules make rental B mechanical; D4 'each shape' is each model; D5 MVA2 is SEEN-fitted for mma.sync; D6 a failed tA-e1cal STOPS rental B; D7 deepseek-v2-lite is SEEN-SHAPE ('new model, seen shapes'); D8 Granite is cut; D9 term (b) not revised first; D10 about $11.4
tool: scorer scripts/scoring/tileA/score_bytes.py; tcommon.named_key; bytes scripts/wave_split_bytes_v4.py (M4 at the tile); row keys scripts/scoring/tileA/rowkeys_tile.py
what: the A key of v4 (D3): which w1 A accounting prices rental B's G-1 cells, where bytes reach time (design-tile 2.4)

pages.same_counts (design-tile-review 9.14): each byte page reads the SAME file as its (model, tile, G)'s timed page, so their counts are identical by construction

keys.CLAMP: v3 with each GEMM's q floored at the active weights once (q_ideal = experts with a row / E): a physical floor, not a fit (design-tile-review 5). M4 prices uniform cells below one weight set at BLOCK_M 128 (Qwen1.5 n 1 w1 q 0.967)
keys.ROWKEY60: rental 6's row-granular LRU at 60 MiB (rental 7's NAMED key, SEEN-chosen, OPEN)
keys.ROWKEY30: the same at 30 MiB: one of the GH200's two L2 partitions (its L2 read 60 MiB on rental 4's rulers, CONSISTENT with RRZE's GH200 run; Hopper's L2 is two partitions, NVIDIA H100 whitepaper). The design's 'Fan et al.' attribution is withdrawn (no source supports it; design-tile-review 9.13)

olmoe-1b-7b-128g1.source: DESIGN (shared-memory rule; the census replaces it)

mixtral-8x7b-64g1.source: DESIGN (shared-memory rule; the census replaces it)

qwen2-57b-a14b-128g1.source: DESIGN (shared-memory rule; the census replaces it)

rowkey_rows.method: streamed (rowkeys_tile.stream_misses): the pinned rival's access order and hit rule with bounded memory (peak 0.25 GB); the pinned rowkeys.simulate's own run on this page was stopped at 19 GB of unified memory on 2026-10-14
rowkey_rows.equality_check: the stream's read bytes EQUAL rowkeys.simulate's (CPU float64, and the MPS float32 run before it was stopped) on all 13 OLMoE 128 G 1 cells that run priced (n 1, 2, 4, 8; 4.2 to 33.8 million accesses each); tests/test_tile_plumbing.py re-runs n 1
rowkey_rows.arms: NATIVE priced, SHARED carried (the same walk at G 1)
rowkey_rows.recompute: re-priced at the census occupancy if it differs from the design occupancy (tileA-census)

deviation: the design's OLMoE 128x128 G 1 n 8 tread is removed (build-tile-review 5): M4 rules w2 at G 1 and n >= 6 ILL-POSED on Hopper (wave_split_bytes.HOPPER_G1_N), applied per tread and literally at BLOCK_M 128 (n 4 is already 512 rows per expert, past BLOCK_M 32's n 6 at 192), so an n-8 cell would have no v4 prediction; OLMoE runs n 1, 2, 4, and the deepest A-heavy w1 row (n 8) is lost

statistic: per (cell, arm, GEMM): q_counted = (dram_bytes_read - n x operand_per_tile_g) / W_g at the tile's BYTE_MODEL; e_K = q_pred_K / q_counted - 1
rule (D3; design-tile-review 5): over EVERY scored w1 row (the G-1 pages: OLMoE 128 G 1, Mixtral 64 G 1, Qwen2-57B 128 G 1; uniform, balanced and skewed, NATIVE and SHARED): the key nearest by rms is NAMED iff the next is at least 2x farther and every row of the nearest is within 5%; if none is NAMED v4 takes CLAMP (the physical floor), not v3. The NAMED key or CLAMP becomes rental B's w1 A key. Mixtral's G-16 rows and every w2 row are printed
brackets_printed: q_group (every M-tile re-reads its expert's slabs, G 1) and q_ideal (active weights once)
B_BYTES_bar_printed: rms <= 3% and every row <= 5% per key on the scored rows

gates.clock: rental 6's counter clock rule (lock_gate.check_page PASS, each cell in [1640, 1710] MHz)
gates.G5: histogram sha256, shuffle seed, every cell's counts sha256
gates.tile: the page's recorded block_m, block_n, block_k, num_warps, num_stages must be the unit's

labels.rows: BLIND-CALMODEL (CAL models); uniform and balanced rows may be SEEN-WORKLOAD (per row)

scorer_ambiguities.1 which c is the denominator, and F's un: c_time = c_card x c_counter(tile) / 344.1 (344.1 the CAL counters' c); F is held in counter cycles and PHI = F / c_counter(tile) in k-steps; at R3's tile v4 is v3 exactly (r3_timing_model_v4.py --check)
scorer_ambiguities.2 F-cyc against F-step: F-step (v3's form) is registered; F-cyc replaces it only when, on the 64x128 w8 pages, it is nearer the measured F on both GEMMs and F-step misses by more than 3 se on one (tcommon.f_form_rule)
scorer_ambiguities.3 eta_mma: per clock (Luo Table 11, 0.991), per instruction by Table 9's ratios: 0.983 (m64n128k16, 128x128 w8), 0.965 (m64n64k16, 64x128); H800 PCIe, FP16; BF16 on GH200 assumed equal; rival Table 9's chip-relative 0.872 / 0.857
scorer_ambiguities.4 tA-floor: the test statistic is u = S c + F per (model, GEMM), within 3%; cells are the NATIVE and SHARED cells at n 4..9 whose own GEMM reads DRAM at no more than 0.5 x 4022 GB/s; a dropped w4 page changes nothing (printed only); at 128x128 v4cal and v4 are the same model
scorer_ambiguities.5 the NAMED rule's rows, and the default: every scored w1 row of the G-1 byte pages (uniform, balanced and skewed, NATIVE and SHARED); nothing NAMED gives CLAMP, not v3
scorer_ambiguities.6 E1-TILE's 'each model': the three BLIND-TILE models; deepseek-v2-lite is in the pooled bar only (its own bar DESCRIPTIVE, never CERTIFIED); a model left with one page is scored and NOT CERTIFIED
scorer_ambiguities.7 the host cut: 0.40 ms (T + F240), rental 3's registered rule, on the FINALISED v4 prediction
scorer_ambiguities.8 tA-rep dropped: rental 3's 0.18% feeds the rivals' se, tA-dead's z and the power at finalisation
scorer_ambiguities.9 tA-e1cal 'fails': on the CLEAN view: the pooled NATIVE bar, each class mean within 0.75%, the 128 G 1 CAL models within 1%; a SKIPPED, LOST or NOT SCORED E1-CAL page, or a G3 void, is a STOP (tileB-stop)
scorer_ambiguities.10 the OLS rival: one ridge OLS over every valid NATIVE E1-CAL cell (features waves, bytes / bw, ln(1 + CTAs); lambda 1e-3 x trace(X'X) / 3 on standardised features); NOT SCORED under 12 cells or condition number over 1e6
scorer_ambiguities.11 census against counter occupancy: integers, exact; a counter page at another occupancy is scored at its recorded one (rental 4's re-key, score_floor: Z_wg at the 128x128 pages' recorded occupancy, each 64x128 page's c at its own); on rental B a (model, tile) at another occupancy than rental A's census is NOT SCORED on every page of that (model, tile), and a missing or refused rental-B census leaves every page NOT SCORED (score_tileB.census_check); a refused rental-A census is a STOP
scorer_ambiguities.12 tA-dead: tread n 1 (uniform and balanced); align growth = (A_S - A_N) at c15 minus at c9 off each page's align_probe; se = 2 sigma_page mean(T) / sqrt(cells), sigma_page tA-rep's or 0.18%
scorer_ambiguities.13 the 30 MiB row key: one of the card's two L2 partitions of its measured 60 MiB (rental 4's rulers, CONSISTENT with RRZE's GH200; Hopper's partitioned L2, NVIDIA H100 whitepaper); the 'Fan et al.' attribution is withdrawn
scorer_ambiguities.14 byte pages and timed pages: one histogram file per (model, tile, G): a byte page and a timed page of the same (model, tile, G) read the same file, so their counts are identical (the files' sha256 above)
